kind: instrumented live diagnostic; not a clean FPS benchmark

measurement_contract.actor_scope: human pose includes skin and its measured authoritative colliders; mosquito pose/collider/skin remain inside mosquito update_state residual; inactive voice callbacks legitimately have zero calls
measurement_contract.do_not_sum: inclusive labels overlap; use call edges and nesting
measurement_contract.inclusive: elapsed wall time around super; contains nested measured calls and synchronous callbacks
measurement_contract.not_measured: native renderer/physics/audio thread work, unwrapped UI or audio callbacks outside measured parents, and engine dispatch; this is not total frame CPU
measurement_contract.overhead: recorder_bookkeeping_ms measures enter/leave bodies once each, excluding wrapper dispatch and timer/accounting operations after its last timestamp; it is not subtracted; parent residuals include child bookkeeping
measurement_contract.path: Brain._path_direction inclusive, not isolated static MapNavigation.path; rebuilds counted by production stats.paths
measurement_contract.physics_rows: only scopes entered during Engine.is_in_physics_frame; idle work never charged to last physics tick
measurement_contract.process_rows: all callbacks keyed by Engine process frame, including physics callbacks before that frame's idle pass
measurement_contract.residual: inclusive minus direct measured child spans; contains unwrapped work and profiler bookkeeping, not pure function self-time
measurement_contract.tick_residual: includes static Arena.step_human, static stunned movement, bookkeeping loops, unwrapped calls and profiler overhead; not a directly timed human-movement label

overhead_calibration.scope: synthetic single-depth collector calls; excludes wrapper dispatch and does not predict nested real cost

scenario: real Main/Client/Practice, valid map spawn, forward/reverse input, 4 humans + 12 mosquitoes + 15 live brains; no scripted global door toggles

view_instrumentation.callback_order: same nodes and callbacks; super implementations retain original order
view_instrumentation.limits: Actor pose includes imported skin work; World process includes visibility/rays; native render/audio threads outside these callbacks are not timed
